Usage: online [options]

Block until the internet — or a named endpoint — is actually healthy.

Options:
  --internet                   Wait for working internet (layered, captive-portal-aware). Default when no check flag is given.
  --once                       Run one cycle and exit (no waiting): exit 0 ready, 1 not ready
  -v, --verbose                Print per-attempt diagnostics to stderr
  --status SPEC                Expected status for --url: 2xx (default), list 200,204, or range 200-299
  --timeout DURATION           Total wait budget, e.g. 30s, 10m. 0 = forever (default: 10m)
  --interval DURATION          Sleep between poll cycles (default: 2s)
  --probe-timeout DURATION     Per-probe DNS/HTTP timeout (default: 3s)
  --url URL                    Wait until URL returns a status matching --status (repeatable)
  --endpoint URL               Override the built-in 204 connectivity endpoints for --internet (repeatable)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  online                                      Wait up to 10m for working internet
  online --once                               Is the internet up right now? (exit 0/1)
  online --internet --url https://api/health  Network back AND my server healthy
  online --url https://x --status 200,204     Wait for an exact status set

Composes with:
  online && retry --times 3 dotnet test  Resume work once the network is back

Exit Codes:
  0    Ready — every requested check healthy
  1    --once only: checked once, not ready right now
  124  Timed out before ready (wait mode)
  125  Usage error: bad arguments, unparseable duration/status, malformed URL
  126  Unexpected error (tool fault)
  130  Interrupted (Ctrl+C)
